archimate:ApplicationService.name: Provider / Facility Registry Service
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation:
This service maintains a verified database of health workers, including their credentials, licenses, and roles. It provides an API for other systems to verify the identity of a clinician.
The purpose is to ensure that all clinical actions can be attributed to a verified professional. This is essential for accountability, patient safety, and the security of the health network.
Example: A service that confirms a user is a licensed surgeon before they are allowed to upload a post-operative summary.
